record.issue_text: Client: isInvalidEmail is never reset on successful add or dialog close, so a stale validation error banner shows on reopen

adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog`, `isInvalidEmail` is set to `true` on validation failure in `handleAdd()`, but it is not reset in the mutation `onSuccess` handler (which only calls `setIsOpenDialog(false)` and `setMultiEmailValue([""])`). Because the dialog component remains mounted and the banner is gated solely on `isInvalidEmail`, reopening the dialog after a successful add can still show the stale error banner. It is only reset on the Cancel button path, and not when closing via success or `onOpenChange`.
